'''2021 Worlds Throwback Top 8 Erich Hawbaker DS Bring Him Before Me''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Erich Hawbaker]] at the [[2021 Worlds Throwback Event]] (Top 8).

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Erich Hawbaker]]
* '''Event:''' [[2021 Worlds Throwback Event]]
* '''Stage:''' Top 8
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Bring Him Before Me / Take Your Father's Place|DS2-D-bringhimbeforeme.gif}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' [[Prepared Defenses]]
